comment: Dr. B is the BEST! I have taken her 3 times over the years. She is thoughtful, kind but critical, and dedicated. She is everything that you want in a professor. If you are struggling, reach out to her. She is so understanding.

I loved her! She really cares about her students and is very knowledgeable. She lets you do corrections on homeworks and her exams are straightforward. I was worried about this class but I ended up enjoying it! A final group project/presentation but it's not bad.

Dr. Blondino is a fantastic professor who is clear in her expectations and has immense knowledge of what she teaches. Her lectures and the material are helpful, and graded items are fair. Students who work hard will do very well and won't drown in work. Dr. Blondino's teaching is amazing, and she is very energetic, which rubs off on her students.

Epi is not everyone's cup of tea but her class is managable. Allows for hw revisions (DO THEM they help your grade). Attendence is mandatory (has exit tickets) but gives multiple out of class ticket oppurtunties to make up. Class is VERY lecture heavy and can be VERY boring but as long as you do the work you will be fine. Exams can be confusing.

she's AWESOME. Tests are not easy (they're not open notes) but she's really helpful during office hours and she really wants everyone to do well. Weekly homework but manageable. She goes really fast so it can be hard to keep up sometimes.
Interesting class that is lecture heavy but also is interactive. The reflections are unclear and he grading can be a little tricky. Quizzes are easy.
Love her. Pretty straight forward class. She provides opportunities to make up for lack of attendance and points lost on homework. Exams are not open-note.

Dr. Blondino is the BEST! Her class is interesting and she cares about her students. She remembers facts about everyone and starts class checking on everyone individually. Her class is the perfect amount of work and she teaches with both lectures and real world activities. She is also always open to feedback if you have ideas to improve the class.
